[Margin comment: preserves a predictable, business-oriented cap while carving out typical uncapped high-risk items — confirm the numeric floor (USD [●]) you want inserted.]  
3) 9.2 Consequential Damages — "Neither Party shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive or consequential damages (including loss of profit, loss of revenue, loss of business, loss of data, or loss of goodwill), even if the Party has been advised of the possibility of such damages; provided, however, that the foregoing exclusion shall not apply to damages arising from (i) a Party's breach of confidentiality, (ii) willful misconduct or gross negligence, (iii) a Party's indemnification obligations under Section 9.3, or (iv) Vendor's loss, corruption or unauthorized disclosure of Customer Data."
